release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.48 completes the Sidebar hierarchy sizing pass. In desktop Sidebar appearance, Tasks now uses the reclaimed viewport height instead of leaving a large dead zone below the workspace while preserving the existing normal-flow/grid interaction model and task-group controls. Generator retailer rows now match the real rendered Tasks retailer row height, logo size, and label scale instead of relying on nominal CSS dimensions. The redundant page-level Generator heading and subtitle are removed entirely so the Generator workspace begins immediately with its hierarchy shell. Chromium regression coverage verifies the hidden Sidebar top header, near-full-height Tasks pane/studio/shell geometry and minimal bottom gap, matching rendered Tasks/Generator retailer dimensions, Generator routing, native group modal behavior, retailer artwork, HTML5 drag persistence, and the 120-task soak.
